message.content: Jennifer Moore offers several strategies for managing muscle soreness. One of her main recommendations is to ensure adequate hydration, as she notes, "Staying hydrated makes such a difference in recovery." She also suggests incorporating a post-workout protein shake or smoothie, emphasizing, "After workouts is generally better! Your muscles are primed to absorb the protein for recovery." Jennifer further advises, "Just try to have it within 30-60 minutes post-workout for the best results." Additionally, she recommends checking the ingredients for added sugars or fillers to ensure the supplement aligns with your nutritional goals. Overall, Jennifer stresses the importance of both immediate recovery and long-term nutrition for reducing muscle soreness.
